name: funtimedesign
description: Claude Code plugins shared across the funtimedesign org: an independent verifier for every agent turn, and an evidence-based gap analysis skill.

plugins.name: crossverify
plugins.description: Stop-hook verifier: a different AI vendor (Codex, read-only) checks the agent's claims after every turn, with gap analysis in every verdict and an optional on-demand second reviewer via Fireworks.

plugins.name: gaps
plugins.description: Evidence-based gap analysis for a plan, spec, project, or system. Every finding is CONFIRMED with file:line, a cited RESEARCH GAP, or an OPEN QUESTION naming the check that settles it.
